capabilities: Generate content at the cursor from a prompt
Rewrite the selected text or entire document
Generate content from a YouTube video's captions
Customize prompt templates and reuse recent prompts
Choose between LLM providers (OpenAI or Ollama) with streaming responses
extras: The README warns that the API key is stored in vault settings and recommends gitignoring the plugin's data.json to avoid committing it; listed future features (more providers, image generation, vault indexing) are not yet available.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate or rewrite note text using large language models from a prompt.
summary: AI assistant that generates or rewrites note content with LLMs (OpenAI, Ollama) from user prompts at the cursor, selection, or document level.
